exposure: Admission prediction nomogram for vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
Low probability of successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (<35%)
High probability of successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (>65%)
Intake prediction nomogram for vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
Moderate probability of successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (35-65%)
outcome: Accuracy of prediction scores for vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
Characteristics associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
cohort: 614 women with at least 1 previous cesarean delivery who attempted a trial of labor from 2007-2016 at a tertiary medical center
finding: The admission prediction nomogram for vaginal birth after cesarean delivery was more accurate and showed higher predicted success compared with the intake nomogram for the same cohort.
